options.content:
ORION DISTANCE-SYNCED LAP COMPARE
Select multiple laps and compare channels against cumulative GPS distance from lap start, like an i2 overlay. If Compare laps is All, the first N laps are loaded automatically.

panels.title: Compare Lap Slots
panels.description: Maps Compare 1..6 traces to real lap numbers.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), all_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS lap,
         start_time,
         LEAD(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS next_time
  FROM classifier, run_bounds
  WHERE type = 'lap' AND start_time BETWEEN run_bounds.run_start AND run_bounds.run_end
), selected_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lap) AS compare_slot,
         lap, start_time, next_time, (next_time - start_time) / 1000.0 AS lap_s,
         CONCAT(start_time, ':', next_time, ':', lap) AS lap_value
  FROM all_laps
  WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (ARRAY[${CompareLaps:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[] AND lap <= ${AutoCompareCount:raw}::int)
      OR CONCAT(start_time, ':', next_time, ':', lap) = ANY(ARRAY[${CompareLaps:singlequote}]::text[])
    )
), samples AS (
  SELECT sl.compare_slot, sl.lap, sl.start_time, sl.next_time, sl.lap_s,
         p.time, d.gps[1]::double precision AS lat, d.gps[2]::double precision AS lon,
         d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph,
         c.apps1_travel AS throttle_pct,
         c.brake_pressure_f AS brake_f_psi,
         d.steer_col_angle AS steer_deg,
         LAG(d.gps[1]::double precision) OVER (PARTITION BY sl.compare_slot ORDER BY p.time) AS prev_lat,
         LAG(d.gps[2]::double precision) OVER (PARTITION BY sl.compare_slot ORDER BY p.time) AS prev_lon
  FROM selected_laps sl
  JOIN packet p ON p.time >= sl.start_time AND p.time < sl.next_time
  JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  WHERE d.gps IS NOT NULL AND array_length(d.gps, 1) >= 2
), distance_samples AS (
  SELECT *,
         SUM(CASE WHEN prev_lat IS NULL OR prev_lon IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE
           2 * 6371000 * ASIN(LEAST(1.0, SQRT(
             POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lat - prev_lat) / 2), 2) +
             COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lon - prev_lon) / 2), 2)
           ))) END) OVER (PARTITION BY compare_slot ORDER BY time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS distance_m
  FROM samples
), binned AS (
  SELECT (FLOOR(distance_m / GREATEST(${DistanceStep:raw}::numeric, 1)) * GREATEST(${DistanceStep:raw}::numeric, 1))::double precision AS distance_m,
         compare_slot,
         AVG(speed_mph) AS speed_mph,
         AVG(throttle_pct) AS throttle_pct,
         AVG(brake_f_psi) AS brake_f_psi,
         AVG(steer_deg) AS steer_deg
  FROM distance_samples
  GROUP BY 1, compare_slot
)
SELECT compare_slot AS compare,
       lap,
       to_char(to_timestamp(start_time / 1000.0), 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS start,
       ROUND(lap_s::numeric, 3) AS "lap time [s]",
       ROUND((lap_s - MIN(lap_s) OVER ())::numeric, 3) AS "delta [s]",
       lap_value,
       start_time AS start_ms,
       next_time AS end_ms
FROM selected_laps
ORDER BY compare_slot;

list.query: WITH selected_partitions AS ( SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time FROM partitions p WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[] OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[]) ), bounds AS ( SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start, LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end FROM selected_partitions ), laps AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS lap, start_time, LEAD(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS next_time FROM classifier, bounds WHERE type = 'lap' AND start_time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end ) SELECT CONCAT('Lap ', lap, ' | ', ROUND(((next_time - start_time) / 1000.0)::numeric, 3), ' s') AS __text, CONCAT(start_time, ':', next_time, ':', lap) AS __value FROM laps WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lap;
